id: HFFINAL: unified final evaluation - final controller (OURS = LCMHF, HFLAT3) vs stepping baseline, three literature release rules on the same hold layer, a literature estimator in our controller, and the original FALCON policy; fresh seeds
registered: 2026-10-29, before any HFFINAL run. Replaces the per-stage comparisons (HFDB/HFABL/HFDBM/HFALL/HFDF2, run with DB/FZ/MX) for the final controller. No change to any arm after registration

arms.B11: stepping baseline B-final 11 (MPC-feasibility step trigger, Khadiv/Smaldone family; step-timing MPC; SME), as HFDB
arms.R2: Li et al. ICRA 2025 predicted-instability release rule (RA_CRC=2 RA_CRC_TOTAL=1 RA_CRC_NOP=1 RA_CRC_EPERSIST=1)
arms.R3: Meng et al. 2025 CP/RHACV release rule (RA_MENG=1 RA_MENG_SCALE=0.884)
arms.R2/R3/CG common: same hold layer and information paths as OURS (IMU-SME, S5 entry, hand-over, RA_FZMIN=0.1, RA_HOLD_REF=m, RA_IMU_K=200, RA2E_N=1, RA_DEC_RAW=1, RA_FF_LP=0.5); only the release rule differs (no ellipse bound, no motion bound, no stance-aware decision; fs_mpc timing [0.2,0.25,0.3,0.4])
arms.MOB: OURS with the tuned momentum observer (run_mt.sh MOBP, gain 30, as HFDBM) instead of IMU-SME; all OURS flags kept
arms.FALCON: original ONNX policy, unchanged (as HFDF2); push cells only

cells.successive (4): x +-60 N then y +-60 N at 6 s (0.2 s each, 10 s); seeds 1334-1339
cells.arm motion (8): ACCAD lift/swing/gesture/jab from 2 s, no push and x+50 N at 3 s; seeds 1330-1333
cells.hand load (4): 1 or 2 kg in the right hand from 1 s; push x+70 or y-50 at 3 s; seeds 1330-1333

outcome: held = failure is None; steps = len(summary steps); FALCON comparison uses contact steps (contact_steps.py) for both arms; tilt-bound events reported separately as HFLAT3

decisions (OURS vs arm r, 80 paired push.SUPERIOR: holds OURS >= r + 5 and one-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05
decisions (OURS vs arm r, 80 paired push.INFERIOR: holds OURS <= r - 5 and one-sided exact McNemar (r better) p < 0.05

primary.F1 vs baseline: vs B11: PASS if NONINFERIOR and FEWER_STEPS
primary.F2 vs literature rules and estimator: vs each of R2, R3, CG, MOB: PASS if not INFERIOR and (SUPERIOR or FEWER_STEPS)
primary.F3 other conditions: arm motion + hand load (48 paired runs) vs B11: holds OURS >= B11 - 3 and steps OURS <= B11
primary.F4 vs FALCON: P1 contact steps OURS <= 0.5 x FALCON and one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 0.05; P2 zero-contact-step holds OURS >= FALCON + 5 and one-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05 (80 push runs). Holds reported without prediction (FALCON was more robust before)

reported: per group and cell; zero-step holds; all pairs' SUPERIOR/INFERIOR
